readiness_statement: All 32,552 required day units are in a terminal discovery-relevant state: 32117 certified native, 406 certified tick fallback, 28 prospectively excluded terminal absences, and 1 explicitly represented UNRESOLVED_DATA_GAP (USDJPY:2010-01-01). The V3.1 discovery semantics prevent any use of invalid data: the unresolved day produces no entry, no exit, no stop/target fill, no executable or synthetic quote, no stateful market-feature update, no zero return, no spread/volatility/ATR update and no ML training example; the clock advances and any pending order advances to the next session-valid executable quote. The unresolved day remains in the data-quality denominator and lineage; it is never counted as certified or excluded.
